en.text: LORD, I have called on you. to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

zhSimplified.text: 愿我的祷告如香陈列在你面前！ ，如献晚祭！

zhTraditional.text: 願我的禱告如香陳列在你面前！ ，如獻晚祭！

en.text: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你禁止我的口，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你禁止我的口，

en.text: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. let me eat of their delicacies.

zhSimplified.text: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪恶，

zhTraditional.text: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪惡，

en.text: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

zhSimplified.text: 任凭义人击打我，仁慈； 头上的膏油；

zhTraditional.text: 任憑義人擊打我，仁慈； 頭上的膏油；

en.text: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

zhSimplified.text: 他们的审判官被扔在岩下；

zhTraditional.text: 他們的審判官被扔在巖下；

en.text: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

footnotes.text: 141:7 Sheol is the place of the dead.

en.text: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. leave my soul destitute.

zhSimplified.text: 主—耶和华啊，我的眼目仰望你；

zhTraditional.text: 主－耶和華啊，我的眼目仰望你；

en.text: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 求你保护我脱离恶人为我设的网罗

zhTraditional.text: 求你保護我脫離惡人為我設的網羅

en.text: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

zhSimplified.text: 愿恶人落在自己的网里，

zhTraditional.text: 願惡人落在自己的網裏，
